title: Two-level domain-decomposition AdaGrad method for scalable training of graph neural networks
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for learning from graph-structured data. However, their efficient training remains challenging, particularly in distributed computing environments. This challenge arises from the use of message passing, which couples all graph nodes, leading to expensive optimization steps, high memory requirements, and substantial communication overhead.
